proof_body:
by
  intro ι s x y u v a b c d mx my mu mv Vx Vy Vu Vv Cxy Cuv r r' hs hVx0 hVy0 hu hv hmx hmy hmu hmv hVx hVy hVu hVv hCxy hCuv hr hr'
  have hn : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
  have hSx : ∑ i ∈ s, x i = s.card * mx := by
    rw [hmx]
    field_simp
  have hSy : ∑ i ∈ s, y i = s.card * my := by
    rw [hmy]
    field_simp
  have hmu' : mu = a * mx + b := by
    rw [hmu, Finset.sum_congr rfl hu, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hSx]
    field_simp
  have hmv' : mv = c * my + d := by
    rw [hmv, Finset.sum_congr rfl hv, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hSy]
    field_simp
  have hVu' : Vu = a ^ 2 * Vx := by
    have h : ∑ i ∈ s, (u i - mu) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * ∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hu i hi, hmu']
      ring
    rw [hVu, hVx, h]
    ring
  have hVv' : Vv = c ^ 2 * Vy := by
    have h : ∑ i ∈ s, (v i - mv) ^ 2 = c ^ 2 * ∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hv i hi, hmv']
      ring
    rw [hVv, hVy, h]
    ring
  have hCuv' : Cuv = a * c * Cxy := by
    have h : ∑ i ∈ s, (u i - mu) * (v i - mv) = a * c * ∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) * (y i - my) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hu i hi, hv i hi, hmu', hmv']
      ring
    rw [hCuv, hCxy, h]
    ring
  have hp : Real.sqrt Vx * Real.sqrt Vy ≠ 0 := (mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hVx0) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hVy0)).ne'
  have hden : Real.sqrt Vu * Real.sqrt Vv = |a * c| * (Real.sqrt Vx * Real.sqrt Vy) := by
    rw [hVu', hVv', Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg a), Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [hr', hr, hden, hCuv', abs_of_pos h, mul_div_mul_left _ _ h.ne']
  · intro h
    rw [hr', hr, hden, hCuv', abs_of_neg h, neg_mul, div_neg, mul_div_mul_left _ _ h.ne]
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (x y u v : ι → ℝ) (a b c d mx my mu mv Vx Vy Vu Vv Cxy Cuv r r' : ℝ), s.Nonempty → 0 < Vx → 0 < Vy → (∀ i ∈ s, u i = a * x i + b) → (∀ i ∈ s, v i = c * y i + d) → mx = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → my = (∑ i ∈ s, y i) / s.card → mu = (∑ i ∈ s, u i) / s.card → mv = (∑ i ∈ s, v i) / s.card → Vx = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) ^ 2) / s.card → Vy = (∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my) ^ 2) / s.card → Vu = (∑ i ∈ s, (u i - mu) ^ 2) / s.card → Vv = (∑ i ∈ s, (v i - mv) ^ 2) / s.card → Cxy = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) * (y i - my)) / s.card → Cuv = (∑ i ∈ s, (u i - mu) * (v i - mv)) / s.card → r = Cxy / (Real.sqrt Vx * Real.sqrt Vy) → r' = Cuv / (Real.sqrt Vu * Real.sqrt Vv) → (0 < a * c → r' = r) ∧ (a * c < 0 → r' = -r)
